title: Mobility of EU citizens increasing
text:
Mobility of EU citizens increasing

## EU citizens living in another EU country on the rise

The EU population has the freedom to move and reside in the different EU Member States. The largest group of EU citizens residing in other EU Member States in 2021 was Romanian citizens (3.0 million or 24.0 % of all EU citizens living in another EU country), followed by Polish (1.5 million or 12.0 %), Italian (1.3 million or 10.6 %) and Portuguese citizens (928 thousand or 7.5 %).

Looking at the period 2017 to 2021, the number of EU citizens living in another EU Member State has increased for 19 EU citizenships, decreased for another seven and remained stable for Spanish citizens. The largest relative increase during this period can be observed for Croatian (+24 %), Lithuanian and Irish (both +15 %) as well as Slovenian and Slovakian citizens (all +14 %).
